title: TrimSMP
description: This Plugin allows you to Unlock powerful abilities based on the armor trim you wear.
body:
# 💎 **TrimSMP**

> **Armor trims are no longer cosmetic—they define your playstyle.**

**TrimSMP** transforms vanilla Minecraft's armor trim system into a complete RPG-inspired progression system. Every armor trim grants unique passive abilities, powerful full-set skills, and strategic advantages, allowing players to create their own combat style using nothing but vanilla smithing mechanics.

**Your armor is your class.**

---

# ✨ **Core Features**

## 🛡️ Build Your Own Class


Every trim represents a completely different playstyle, encouraging experimentation and unique builds for PvP, SMPs, and survival.

Examples include:

- 🔥 **Sentry** — Defensive Juggernaut
- ⚡ **Vex** — Agile Assassin
- 🌿 **Tide** — Support & Utility
- 💀 **Rib** — High-Risk Berserker
- 🌀 **Eye** — Endwalker
- 💰 **Snout** — Prosperity & Fortune

...and many more unique trims.

---

# ⚙️ **How It Works**

Using the vanilla Smithing Table, players apply armor trims just like normal Minecraft.

Each trimmed armor piece grants passive abilities that become stronger as more matching pieces are equipped.

### Piece Scaling

🧩 **1 Piece**
- Small passive bonus

🧩 **2 Pieces**
- Enhanced passive abilities

🧩 **3 Pieces**
- Powerful passive effects

🧩 **4 Pieces (Full Set)**
- Unlock the trim's unique Active Ability (Ultimate)

Every armor piece matters.

---

# 🔋 **Energy System**

Powerful abilities require **Energy** instead of being spammed endlessly.

Energy:

- Regenerates over time
- Balances PvP
- Prevents ability spam
- Rewards smart ability management

Timing your abilities is just as important as choosing the right trim.

---

---

# ⚔️ Perfect For

- SMP Servers
- Lifesteal
- PvP
- Hardcore Survival
- RPG Servers
- Vanilla+ Experiences

---

# ❤️ Why TrimSMP?

Most plugins simply give players potion effects.

**TrimSMP goes much further.**

It transforms one of Minecraft's most underused vanilla features into a complete progression and combat system where every armor choice matters.

Instead of choosing a class from a GUI...

You forge your identity through your armor.

Every trim changes the way you fight.

Every battle becomes strategic.

Every player can create their own build.

---

# 🚀 Forge Your Identity

**Choose your trim.**

**Unlock its abilities.**

**Master your build.**
